newsitem.title: ITALY: 350 illegal immigrants seized off Sicilian coast.
newsitem.headline: 350 illegal immigrants seized off Sicilian coast.

text.p: Around 350 illegal immigrants were seized off the coast of Sicily overnight as they tried to row ashore in rubber dinghies, police said on Friday.
They said the immigrants, from Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and other countries, boarded the dinghies from a Turkish ship three km (two miles) off the island's southeast coast.
The Italian coastguard surrounded the ship and escorted it into port where police arrested five Turkish crew members on charges of trafficking in illegal immigrants.
The immigrants were being held at a sports ground.
Sicily and its smaller islands are often targeted by illegal immigrants searching for a port of entry into Europe.
